cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me as the expedition photographer, not Martin. A sponsor needs usable pictures, not just lovely dunes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Martin won an award for his desert photographs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For landscapes. Your sponsor wants people using the equipment. I'll frame the flask where the logo can be read.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want the logo in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it faces the lens, not the sun. Give me the brief; we'll settle the difference before anyone packs a camera.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 corrects the selection criterion to sponsor usefulness, A3 distinguishes landscapes from branded use and A5 insists on orientation before accepting the brief.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 rival award causes A3 deliverable distinction; B4 logo in every image causes A5 strict lens-facing preparation.

relationship.evidence: B4 supplies a legitimate sponsor requirement that changes the detail of the pitch.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 stronger requirement into a reason to give A the brief before equipment is packed.

specificity.evidence: A1 expedition, B2 rival credentials and A3 equipment flask make the employment choice clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 concise technical requirement and brief request replace the imagined forty-photo failure.
